newsitem.title: USA: Chart says sets 3-for-2 stock split.
newsitem.headline: Chart says sets 3-for-2 stock split.

text.p: Chart Industries Inc said Monday its board has declared a three-for-two stock split that will be distributed on June 30 to shareholders of record June 16.
The company said payment for fractional shares will be made in cash based upon the closing price on June 16.
The company said it will have about 14.4 million common shares outstanding following the split.

Chart said its stock has appreciated in the past two years, and its goal in declaring this stock split is to increase the number of shares outstanding and improve the stock's liquidity, making it more accessible to a wider audience of investors.
